# Public protocol fixtures

The requests and exact review frames cover both registration release modes.
The account is derived from published BIP32 test vector 1; all identities,
openings and values are neutral synthetic data. The signed PSBT bytes were
produced by Namecoin Core 28.0.0 on isolated regtest. The result receipt fields
and acknowledgements are format examples, not protected journal, biometric or
custody evidence. No live account, wallet, owner value or grant authority is
included. Negative examples specify the intended parser refusal.
